mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates on future equity cash flows and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate was 0.08% in November 2021, indicating a low-rate environment prior to potential tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE was 4.1% in November 2021, just above the 4.0% threshold
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives inflationary expectations and leads to higher real yields, reducing equity attractiveness and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST was 1579.0 in October 2021, above the 1500.0 threshold
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO was 100.1861 in October 2021, just above the 100.0 threshold
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both consumer spending (CPIAUCSL) and residential investment (HOUST) signal strong aggregate demand pressures that elevate inflation expectations and prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market overheating condition that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered periods, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a central bank response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand that increases inflationary pressures and triggers forward-looking monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 was 21617.828 in July 2021, indicating strong GDP growth
fact:HOUST was 1579.0 in October 2021, indicating high housing demand
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are high, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
